opinions.text:
On writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of Minnesota.

Per Curiam:

As it appears that no final judgment has been entered, the writ of certiorari is dismissed as improvidently granted. Beaupre v. Noyes, 138 U. S. 402; National Life Ins. Co. v. Scheffer, 131 U. S. (Appx.) cciii.
